clause: Layer FX - overlays, stroke, feather, round corners, scribble (cross-domain) [STU-FX-025,STU-FX-026]

scope.summary: Implement the remaining cross-domain layer-fx StudioLiveFilter kinds consuming the same StudioSwatch/StudioGradient/StudioPattern primitives as fills (14.8): Color Overlay (solid StudioSwatch), Gradient Overlay (linear/radial/angle/reflected/diamond, scale/angle/align-with-layer), Pattern Overlay (StudioPattern tile, scale/link), Stroke / Outline fx (inside/center/outside, swatch/gradient/pattern), Feather edge (fade to transparent over radius; R,V,T,G), Round Corners (vector-native corner rounding by radius; V,T), Scribble (hand-drawn scribble hatching: angle/path-overlap/stroke-width/curviness/spacing; V,T).
acceptance_criteria: Color/Gradient/Pattern Overlay, Stroke/Outline fx, Feather, Round Corners, Scribble; reuse fill color primitives
expected_tests: test: overlays reuse StudioSwatch/Gradient/Pattern (no fork); Stroke inside/center/outside; Round Corners + Scribble on vector geometry

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
